description: Resolve PR review defects and validate rewritten push history against accepted default-branch history.
rationale: User requested fixing PR comments and CI failures.
requirements: Synchronize writer-lock contenders using a held lock and explicit pipes; verify retries preserve accepted updates.
Retain each distinct byte diff for the process lifetime without changing interval or relocation semantics.
Doctor reports actionable reference diagnostics and repair guidance when an intent head is missing.
Historical queries accept predecessor published schemas while still checking record schemas and hashes; working queries retain strict published-schema pins.

CI validates rewritten branch history from its accepted default-branch merge base when the push before SHA is missing or divergent; branch creation still validates HEAD and PRs retain their explicit base.
title: Deterministic locking, lifetime cache, resilient queries and force-push CI
